summary: S&P Global Inc. filed an 8-K announcing that its subsidiary Mobility Global Inc. commenced a $2 billion private offering of senior notes due 2029, 2031, and 2036. The offering precedes the planned spin-off of S&P Global's Mobility division to shareholders. Mobility Global is a newly formed holding company for the Mobility division. The notes are offered to qualified institutional buyers (Rule 144A) and non-U.S. persons (Regulation S). The filing uses Rule 135c to publicize the offering without constituting a formal offer. Watch for the spin-off completion timeline and potential impact on S&P Global's capital structure.
